title: Neuroscience, HCI & Cognitive Research Lead (All Gender)
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Neuroscience, HCI \& Cognitive Research Lead is a high\-level, senior individual contributor (IC) role designed for an expert who bridges the gap between cognitive neuroscience, quantitative Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and high\-density interface design.


Instead of managing people, you will lead the scientific and interaction strategy for the Doodle product ecosystem. Your goal is to systematically decode how humans perceive time, experience decision fatigue during group time coordination, and interact with automated time\-creation systems. You will turn hard cognitive metrics into concrete design principles that our product and UX teams can execute immediately.

### **What You’ll Actually Do**

**1\. Strategic Research Leadership**

* Establish and track **quantitative cognitive KPIs** to measure interaction quality across all core workflows.
* Embed behavioral evaluation frameworks directly into the quarterly product roadmap prioritization process.
* Identify and mitigate behavioral and cognitive risks in product feature specs before they reach engineering development.

**2\. Applied Neuroscience \& Cognitive Research**

* Design and execute rigorous experiments evaluating user attention allocation, interruption costs, and information processing limits.
* Conduct deep\-dive research into **temporal cognition**, which is how users psychologically process time, waiting periods, and availability synchronization.
* Translate neuro\-cognitive theories of habit formation and collective coordination into practical product loops.

**3\. HCI \& High\-Density Interface Design**

* Analyze and optimize complex, high\-density time coordination interfaces to minimize visual noise and cognitive friction.
* Develop clear, neuroscience\-informed guidelines for font hierarchy, information chunking, and layout structures that reduce user anxiety during high\-stakes availability matching.
* Evaluate the psychological boundaries of **Human\-AI interaction**, focusing on building appropriate user trust, transparency, and control in automated time\-creation flows.

**4\. Interaction \& Systems Thinking**

* Map holistic user attention flows across asynchronous digital ecosystems, looking beyond single\-page sessions to understand multi\-day coordination loops.
* Diagnose systemic cognitive bottlenecks in complex B2B group time\-creation journeys.
* Predict and measure the downstream psychological effects of notifications, alerts, and calendar interruptions on user focus.

**5\. Organizational Research Enablement**

* Run targeted workshops and continuous coaching sessions for Product Managers (PMs) and Product Designers to upgrade internal literacy in behavioral economics and HCI principles.
* Build a reusable, centralized repository of cognitive design patterns, validation checklists, and experimental frameworks.
* Scale evidence\-based product development by teaching teams how to run quick, statistically valid A/B behavioral checks.

**6\. Long\-Term Innovation Research**

* Craft early, visionary interaction prototypes utilizing AI tools to rapidly simulate underlying logic, test behavioral hypotheses, and represent complex systemic ideas.
* Anticipate the future of asynchronous alignment by exploring next\-generation paradigms: ambient computing, voice/natural language coordination, and zero\-UI predictive automation.
* Build foundational mental models for how users will collaborate as AI agents increasingly handle automated time creation on their behalf.

**7\. Product Strategy \& Business Impact**

* Align user cognitive comfort directly with core B2B business metrics, proving how reduced decision fatigue drives increased user retention, higher conversion rates, and lower churn.
* Synthesize complex academic and experimental data into crisp, highly commercial briefs for executive leadership to steer long\-term portfolio investments.

#### **High\-Complexity Technical Scopes**


To illustrate the expected depth of this role, you will architect and execute research initiatives addressing multi\-layered cognitive and behavioral friction points:

**Scenario A: Structural Complexity and Working Memory Constraints in Collective Alignment**

* **The Problem:** Multi\-party, multi\-layered time coordination inherently scales cognitive friction due to the high volume of asynchronous variables processed simultaneously. When interaction systems fail to account for biological limits on visual working memory, users experience rapid cognitive fatigue, stalling the time\-creation lifecycle.
* **Your Scope:** You will architect advanced, non\-invasive experimental protocols to evaluate how distinct information architecture patterns tax human processing capacity. Your role is to define the fundamental cognitive thresholds that govern complex data visualization in coordination systems, equipping our core design and engineering teams with the foundational interaction rules needed to prevent cognitive overload.

**Scenario B: Dynamic Calibration of Intent and Automation in AI\-Mediated Systems**

* **The Problem:** The shifting frontier of intelligent, predictive systems introduces a fundamental human\-machine friction point: balancing user intent with autonomous system execution. In structural time creation, poor calibration of this boundary triggers either hyper\-vigilant friction (due to low trust) or systemic errors (due to automation complacency).
* **Your Scope:** You will design systemic Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI) evaluation methodologies to study user agency across varying levels of automated coordination. By mapping how changes in interface responsiveness, information transparency, and state\-sharing affect user mental models, you will establish the baseline psychological criteria required for humans to seamlessly co\-operate with autonomous agents.

### **What do you bring?**

**Years of Experience \& Environments**

* **7 to 12\+ years** of post\-qualification experience as an applied researcher, product strategist, or interaction architect.
* Must have a proven track record operating within **fast\-paced commercial digital product companies** (SaaS, B2B/B2C productivity tools, collaboration platforms, or high\-velocity tech labs).
* *Note:* Purely academic profiles or individuals who have only worked in traditional UX agency settings will not have the required product exposure for this role.

**Technical \& Scientific Maturity**

* **Educational Depth:** Master’s or PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, Behavioral Economics, or Experimental/Computational Psychology.
* **Methodological Mastery:** Deep expertise in advanced experimental design, statistical analysis, quantitative usability testing, eye\-tracking methodologies, cognitive load testing, and longitudinal behavioral studies.
* **The Blueprint Balance:** You possess the scientific maturity to know when to demand strict academic rigor and when to optimize for rapid tech\-product velocity.

**Autonomy \& Product Exposure**

* **100% Autonomous Execution:** This is a senior IC role. You do not need a manager to scope your projects, build your test environments, or interpret your data. You own the cognitive research roadmap end\-to\-end.
* **Deep Design \& Product Fluency:** You speak the native language of product squads. You can effortlessly jump into a Figma file with a Principal Product Designer to critique layout density, sit with a PM to redefine a feature's conversion funnel, or sync with a Data Scientist on behavioral telemetry tracking.

**Expected Outcomes \& Measurable Metrics**


Success in this role will not be judged by the number of research papers written, but by the tangible improvement of our user experience and product metrics:

* **Product Performance:** Measurable reduction in user drop\-off rates and time\-to\-completion within high\-density time creation workflows.
* **Cognitive Efficiency:** Lowered subjective and objective cognitive friction indexes across core user journeys, verified through continuous panel testing.
* **Design Velocity:** Creation of a finalized, adopted "Doodle Cognitive Design Manual" used daily by product design teams to ship interfaces that respect human attention.
* **Strategic Moat:** Development of proprietary, defensible behavioral frameworks around how humans coordinate time, positioning Doodle as the definitive global thought leader in the evolution of interaction system design.

### **Why Doodle?**

* **Real Impact:** Your commits will change how the world meets.
* **Technical Stretch:** We deal with "Time" problems most companies never encounter. It’s a masterclass in distributed logic.


At Doodle, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual trust and respect, where equal employment opportunities (EEO) are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to age, race, color, disability, religion, gender, and sexual orientation. Diversity and inclusion are of utmost importance to us. We’re committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work and our products will be. We want to hear from you, so please don’t hesitate to apply!We look forward to receiving your full application.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Better Places (d/f/m)
description:
**What is working at Bettermile like?** 




  




* We mean it when we say “cutting edge” and have a high level of creative freedom in our everyday work.
* You will be surrounded by like\-minded, driven, skilled, and highly motivated people who are keen to contribute to successful solutions.
* We mean diversity, and we put it in numbers: 130\+ people, 36 languages, 35% female (vs. ø26% in the tech industry), ø33 years of age, and yes, we do have Schlager\-Fans among us.
* We have a very supportive and appreciative working environment with a lot of autonomy, a flat hierarchy, and professional growth possibilities.
* We work in a hybrid mode, with weekly team days for better collaboration and nurturing interpersonal connections. When onsite, we work in a modern, kid\- and pet\-friendly Better Space in the heart of Berlin\-Kreuzberg.
* Remote work from anywhere for up to 12 weeks in total per year.
* 30 vacation days in a 5\-day/week working model.
* Kindergarten grant and a Company Pension scheme.
* Regular team breakfasts, fitness \& wellness classes, company runs, and other events. Fruits, snacks, drinks, and coffee with a variety of milk are a given \- but yes, we have them.
* Outstanding flexibility we are proud of – and, of course, the best colleagues in the world!



  





**About the Team** 




 Location data sits at the heart of every delivery, and the Better Places tribe owns the address intelligence that makes those deliveries possible. We ingest messy, real\-world address inputs, normalise them, correct geocoding errors, and enrich them with open and proprietary data—all at a scale of hundreds of millions of requests per month.
 



 Within the tribe, the Geo Solutions team builds and maintains the data pipelines that power our address enrichment, first\-mile routing, and last\-meter delivery features. We focus on building scalable, observable, and high\-quality geodata workflows that enable fast onboarding of new markets and continuous improvement in existing ones.
 



  





**Our Tech Stack** 




 Development: Python, SQL
 



 Warehouses and ML: AWS suite (Athena, Sagemaker), Snowflake
 



 Data pipelines: dbt
 



 Orchestration and Scheduling: Dagster
 



 Dashboarding: Quicksight / Metabase / Streamlit
 



 AI: Copilot / Claude
 



  





**You will be taking care of** 



* Driving the evolution of our delivery intelligence platform, with a focus on developing ML models that optimise the final steps of a delivery and increase productivity for field drivers.
* Delivering customer\-facing, production\-ready systems integrated into Bettermile's product suite.
* Shaping the long\-term strategy for hyperlocal delivery intelligence by identifying where it has the largest impact and the most value for customers.
* Driving cross\-team initiatives, contributing to the long\-term data strategy, and mentoring more junior data scientists.



  





**You check these boxes** 



* 5\+ years in Data Science deploying complex models.
* Thorough understanding of machine learning algorithms and translating them into tangible business solutions.
* Proficient in designing advanced analytics systems and embedding them smoothly into existing product landscapes.
* Proven ability to autonomously build strategies from scratch and extract high\-impact insights from vast datasets.
* Strong ownership mindset used to drive cross\-functional projects and mentor junior team members.



  





**It is awesome if you also have** 



* Experienced in tackling geospatial data challenges (a strong asset).
* Hands\-on experience or a deep interest in applying LLMs and modern AI\-driven features in a product environment.



  





**Take your chance** 




  





 Be a part of shaping a fast\-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing, and quick decision\-making that moves things forward.
 



 Currently, we’re proceeding only with candidates authorized to work in Germany or who already hold a Job Seeker Visa.
 



  





**About us** 




  





 At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last\-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.
 



 Our geo\-based, AI\-powered SaaS product handles complex address processing, dynamic routing, and navigation. It is built to manage many stops and multiple constraints.
 



 We’re setting a new standard for the last mile and pushing the industry forward, powered by a skilled, international team of tech enthusiasts, logistics experts, and a product suite designed to keep evolving.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Consumer Analytics
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self\-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

**About The Consumer Group**
 As the name Consumer Group implies, this group is responsible for building and developing Wolt’s consumer\-facing products. The core mission is to master the user experience while scaling up the platform to enable delivering a mall in a pocket.
   

  

**About The Consumer Analytics Team**
 The team partners closely with Wolt's product organization and business partners to make sure the right insights reach the right people at the right time, building a culture where data is a natural part of how we work, not a bottleneck or an afterthought.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision\-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data\-driven experience that requires a good mix of technical and stakeholder engagement skills. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics or data science role. Data Scientists at Wolt take ownership of the business outcomes.
   

  

 If you enjoy finding patterns amidst the chaos, are excited to build from 0 to 1, and have experience using data science skills to solve business problems, we're looking for someone like you.
   

  

 Our humble expectations
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position
* Experience working with product funnels and user journeys
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Expertise in statistical analysis, including A/B testing using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development (preferably consumer\-facing)
* Experience in using AI in your work to accelerate work velocity, automate repetitive tasks, and generate SQL queries and experiment readouts
* Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Tableau, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar
* Relentless pursuit of new ideas, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data\-driven, hypothesis\-based approach


 What we offer
   

  

* The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges together with opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real\-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and so interesting company to practice analytics!
* You can choose the location from our tech hubs Berlin, Helsinki and Stockholm, or you can work entirely remotely anywhere in Germany, Finland and Sweden. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙
* You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement. Read more about how we work.


 Next steps
   

  

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
   

  

 For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner \- Zhanna Filintseva (zhanna.filintseva@wolt.com)
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Python, ML & Signal-Processing
description:
**DATATRONiQ** 
 ist ein Deep\-Tech\-Startup aus Deutschland für Industrial IoT und Edge AI. Als Senior Data Scientist bei uns trainierst Du Machine\-Learning\-Modelle auf Basis von realen Maschinen\- und Sensordaten – weltweit, vom mittelständischen Fertiger bis zum DAX\-Konzern. Anomalieerkennung, Predictive Maintenance und Qualitätsüberwachung in Echtzeit. Die Daten sind echt, die Maschinen stehen in laufenden Produktionen, und Deine Modelle entscheiden mit darüber, ob eine Anlage planmäßig läuft oder ungeplant stillsteht. Wenn Du Modelle lieber im produktiven Einsatz siehst als in Notebooks optimierst, dann melde Dich gerne bei uns.
 



  





**Über die Stelle** 




  





 Du verantwortest den gesamten Data\-Science\-Lifecycle – von Exploration über Feature Engineering und Modelltraining bis zu Deployment und Validierung, je nach Kundensituation auf Edge\-Gateway, on\-prem Server oder in der Cloud. Die Zeitreihen kommen aus realen Industriesteuerungen über OPC\-UA und MQTT; Feature Engineering heißt hier Signalverarbeitung auf verrauschten Sensordaten, nicht das Umschaufeln aufbereiteter Tabellenspalten. Deine Modelle werden quantisiert, zu ONNX exportiert und laufen direkt dort, wo die Produktion sie braucht – mit allen Konsequenzen, die das für Modellwahl, Latenz und Speicherverbrauch hat.
 



  





**Dein Stack:** 
 Python, PyTorch oder scikit\-learn, ONNX für das Edge\-Deployment und die gängigen MLOps\-Werkzeuge für Versionierung und Reproduzierbarkeit.
 



  





 Wir arbeiten in einem kleinen, eng abgestimmten Team. Code Reviews und Pair Programming gehören fest zum Alltag. Freitags zeigen wir uns interessante Funde im Web und neue Tools in unseren Show\-and\-Tell\-Sessions. Als Data Scientist arbeitest Du eng mit Data Engineers und Backend\-Entwicklern zusammen: Du baust die Modelle, sie bauen die Pipelines, und gemeinsam bringen wir beides in die Produktion.
 



  





**Was sind Deine Aufgaben?** 




  




* Du trainierst ML\-Modelle zur Anomalieerkennung, Predictive Maintenance und Qualitätsüberwachung und validierst sie auf realen Produktionsdaten und Zeitreihen aus Industriesteuerungen.
* Du machst Feature Engineering auf verrauschten Sensor\- und Maschinensignalen (OPC\-UA, MQTT, MES\-Exporte), inklusive Signalverarbeitung und Filterung.
* Du deployst Modelle dorthin, wo der Kunde sie braucht – Edge\-Gateway, on\-prem Server oder Cloud: Quantisierung, ONNX\-Export, teilweise mit begrenzten CPU\- und RAM\-Ressourcen, Tuning und Monitoring im Feld.
* Du arbeitest eng mit Data Engineers und Backend\-Entwicklern zusammen, damit Modelle zuverlässig in unseren Produktions\-Pipelines laufen – nicht als Prototyp in Notebooks.
* Du misst Modelle nicht nur an deren F1\- oder AUC\-Scores, sondern daran, was sie im Produktivbetrieb wirklich leisten: weniger ungeplante Stillstände, höhere Ausbringung, weniger Fehler.
* Du wirkst aktiv an Produkt\-Roadmap und technischen Entscheidungen mit – wir erwarten Meinungen, nicht nur Abarbeitung von Tickets.



  





**Was solltest Du mitbringen?** 




  




* Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem verwandten Fach.
* Mindestens drei Jahre sehr praxisnahe Erfahrung mit Python, gängigen ML\-Frameworks (PyTorch, scikit\-learn, usw.) und Modell\-Deployment in Produktionsumgebungen.
* Erfahrung mit Zeitreihenanalyse und Signalverarbeitung – wir erwarten kein PhD\-Niveau, aber Du weißt, warum ein naiver MLP auf verrauschten Industriesignalen scheitert.
* Grundkenntnisse in MLOps: Versionierung von Modellen und Daten, reproduzierbare Pipelines, Tests für ML\-Code.
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
* Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen und im Team vertreten – auch gegen eine Mehrheit, wenn Du starke Argumente hast.
* Bonus: Erfahrung mit Edge\-Deployment (ONNX, TensorRT, Quantisierung), industriellen Protokollen (OPC\-UA, MQTT) oder LLMs für Chat und agentische Aufgaben.



  





**Was erwartet Dich?** 




  




* Echte End\-to\-End\-Verantwortung: von der Konzeption der Datenerfassung in der Produktion über die Pipeline bis zur Modellinferenz – auf Edge\-Gateway, on\-prem Server oder in der Cloud.
* Das Team entscheidet über Architektur, Tooling und Testabdeckung selbst.
* Agentische Werkzeuge im Alltag: Codex, Claude Code und neue Entwicklungspraktiken – wir probieren früh aus und nutzen, was funktioniert.
* Überwiegend vor Ort in
 **Stuttgart, Ulm oder Berlin** 
 – Industrial\-IoT\-Projekte für Kunden weltweit, vom mittelständischen Fertiger bis zum DAX\-Konzern.



  





**Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?** 




  





 Bei DATATRONiQ bist Du kein kleines Rädchen im Getriebe, Du gestaltest mit und bringst Deine Ideen ein. Du wirst die einzigartige Möglichkeit haben, an einem Produkt zu arbeiten, das das Potenzial hat, einen signifikaten Einfluss im industriellen Fertigungssektor zu haben. Wenn Du Deine Fähigkeiten einsetzen möchtest, um anspruchsvolle Probleme zu lösen und Du Dich aktiv bei uns einbringen willst, dann würden wir sehr gerne mit Dir sprechen!
 



  





 Nimm unter
 **work@datatroniq.com** 
 Kontakt zu uns auf. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
 



  





*Wir bitten Personalvermittlungsagenturen und Headhunter, von einer Kontaktaufnahme abzusehen.*

Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
   

  

 Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.
   

  

 Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.
   

  

 Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R\&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.
   

  

 Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R\&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!
   

  

 What's the opportunity?
   

  

 Fin's Machine Learning team is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.
   

  

 We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated ML product engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.
   

  

 We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting\-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.
   

  

 What will I be doing?
   

  

* Identify areas where ML can create value for our customers
* Identify the right ML framing of product problems
* Working with teammates and Product and Design stakeholders
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and research
* Deeply understand the problem area
* Research and identify the right algorithms and tools
* Being pragmatic, but innovating right to the cutting\-edge when needed
* Perform offline evaluation to gather evidence an algorithm will work
* Work with engineers to bring prototypes to production
* Plan, measure \& socialize learnings to inform iteration
* Partner deeply with the rest of team, and others, to build excellent ML products


 What skills might I need?
   

  

* Broad applied machine learning knowledge
* 3\-5 years applied ML experience
* Practical stats knowledge (experiment design, dealing with confounding etc)
* Intermediate programming skills
* Strong communication skills, both within engineering teams and across disciplines.
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Typically have advanced education in ML or related field (e.g. MSc)
* Scientific thinking skills


 Bonus skills \& attributes
   

  

* Track record shipping ML products
* PhD or other experience in a research environment
* Deep experience in an applicable ML area. E.g. NLP, Deep learning, Bayesian methods, Reinforcement learning, clustering
* Strong stats or math background
* Visualization, data skills, SQL, matplotlib, etc.


**Benefits**
 We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!
   

  

* Competitive salary, annual bonus and equity
* Regular compensation reviews \- we reward great work!
* Generous paid time off above statutory minimum
* Generous family leave (maternity, paternity), to let you spend valuable time with your loved ones
* Hybrid working
* MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed.
* Unlimited access to Claude Code and best\-in\-class AI tools; experimentation \& building is encouraged \& celebrated
* Fun events for employees, friends, and family!


**Policies**
 Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
   

  

 We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone.  Let's start with the basics! Klar is a Mexican fintech startup whose mission is to democratize and revolutionize the way in which financial services have been delivered so far in Mexico, especially since half of the population doesn't have a bank account. We offer a rich set of products across our debit and credit offers and the future is bright for Klar!
   

  

 We have an exciting and ambitious roadmap to bring more features to our products so that we can better serve our users. We have served more than 7 million users since our launch in 2019 — and we're just getting started.
   

  

 Most recently, we partnered with Uber to launch their first global credit card, right here in Mexico; a testament to the trust we've built with world\-class partners and the strength of our infrastructure, team, and product.
   

  

 We are also proud to have been certified in 2023 as a "Great Place to Work" in Mexico — we've worked hard to make that happen and will continue to make bigger strides in the future! Sound like a place you’d like to be?
   

  

 Our people
   

  

 If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed into a team which is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (parents, LGBTQ\+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!
   

  

 Our values
   

  

* Ownership \- We own our successes \& our failures as a team.
* Excellence \- We do everything to the best of our ability \& always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.
* Inclusion \- We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.
* Customer Obsession \- We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers \& it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.
* Klarity \- We communicate clearly \& with authenticity. It’s in our name \& it’s what we do.


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Individual Contributor to join our Credit Card team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing and improving our Machine Learning models; and collaborate with other team members to continuously explore the application of cutting edge technologies to credit risk. This is a full\-time remote position operating on European time zones. We are open to candidates based in Germany or elsewhere within the EU, provided they can work effectively within EU business hours.
   

  

 What you can expect:
   

  

* Design, build, and optimize Machine Learning models powering origination, behavioral scoring, limit management, and early\-warning systems
* Leverage alternative data sources including transaction behavior, merchant data, and device intelligence to improve predictive performance
* Evaluate and implement the infrastructure required to deploy, monitor, and retrain models at scale
* Explore the applications of novel architectures (transformers, foundational models, etc.) for credit risk and related tasks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for data\-driven insights and solutions
* Work with other members of the Credit Risk team to build credit policies across the full customer lifecycle: origination, limit management, restructuring, and write\-offs
* A lot of autonomy and ownership: you will own at least one Machine Learning model end\-to\-end
* Communicate findings and insights to technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 What we are looking for:
   

  

* Master's degree or above in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
+ Experience with Machine Learning libraries such as Scikit\-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, Keras, and Pytorch

* Experience owning models or analytical systems end to end, including performance monitoring, retraining, documentation, and stakeholder alignment
* Comfort using AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code and Codex, to improve productivity
* Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and manipulation tools such as Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn
* Optional, but a plus:
+ Experience with credit risk, fraud, underwriting, lending, financial services, or another regulated decisioning domain
+ Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool) to transform SQL data
+ Experience working with novel, transformer\-based architectures

* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think creatively
* Ability to communicate model tradeoffs, risk implications, and business impact to technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 Our offer to you
   

  

* Competitive salary based on performance and experience
* Chance of earning Klar stock options
* 26 days of paid vacation per year
* Computer devices
* Wellhub subscription to offer mental and physical health
* Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via Modern Health
* Training budget to upskill your learning
* Health insurance \& Pension scheme
* BVG Corporate ticket
* Berlin office if you prefer to work onsite
* International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people
* A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in


*Klar is a safe place for everyone!*
*We trust our highly skilled and diverse team and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity.*
*Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!*

 As our Data Engineer, you'll own the data that powers everything we do \- the flow of cement and concrete plant data from raw, messy ingestion through cleaning, to the pipelines our machine\-learning recommendations run on. description:
Founding Data Scientist
 



  





 Cubiq Recruitment \| Munich, Bavaria, Germany (On\-site)
 



  





 AI HealthTech Startup \| Munich City Centre \| €90,000 to €130,000 \+ Equity
 



  





 We are partnering with an early\-stage AI HealthTech company in Munich that is turning smartphones into screening devices \- measuring 60\+ biomarkers from face, voice, and eyes in under two minutes. No hardware. No friction. Just preventive healthcare in everyone's pocket.
 



  





 The company is seed\-backed, already generating meaningful ARR, and is now building its permanent internal team. After moving quickly with external support, they are hiring their first Founding Data Scientist to own the ML layer from day one.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to shape both the science and the product at a company with genuine ambition, strong funding, and a mission that matters.
 



  





 The Opportunity:
 


* As Founding Data Scientist, you will be the first dedicated data science hire and a core member of the founding team. You will own the machine learning stack end\-to\-end \- from research and development through to production deployment \- and directly shape how the product evolves.
* This is not a role for someone who wants to hand off to engineering. You will build, ship, and own real models that go in front of real users.



  





 For the right person, this role has a clear path to Head of Data Science as the team scales.
 



  





 What You Will Be Doing:
 


* You will design and deploy ML models that power customer\-facing features \- recommendation systems, biomarker estimation from video, audio, and text data, and signal processing across multimodal inputs.
* You will work on a unique digital twin dataset composed of voice recordings, face videos, eye images, digital biomarkers, blood biomarkers, and more \- one of the richest multimodal health datasets being built anywhere.
* You will contribute to the next generation of Doctor AI: a reasoning engine that drafts safe, evidence\-based medical protocols, and lay the groundwork for a conversational medical agent.
* You will work directly alongside the founding team and their ML Lead \- a former ML Lead at Machine Medicine, ex\-Lead Biostatistician at ICON, with publications in Nature and a successful FDA\-approved AI algorithm \- to set the technical direction for data science at the company.



  





 What They Are Looking For:
 


* The ideal person has strong statistical and ML foundations and has built and shipped real models in a production environment. You are comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity, and you treat "it's not my job" as a foreign concept.
* Strong Python skills are essential, alongside experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch), recommendation systems or signal processing, and a solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
* An MSc or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field is expected. Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare or banking is a strong advantage. Research experience and scientific publications are a genuine plus.
* Most importantly, you care about impact. You want to do work that matters.



  





 Useful Backgrounds:
 


* This could suit someone coming from a healthtech, digital health, or biomedical AI background, or from a high\-ownership startup or scaleup environment where pace and quality both matter.
* What matters most is that you are a builder \- someone who gets genuinely excited about deploying models that change how people interact with their own health.



  





 Why This Role Is Interesting:
 


* The mission is real. Prevention is broken \- 60% of people skip health screening because it is slow, invasive, or outdated. This company is fixing that with a product that is already in market, already generating revenue, and backed by unicorn founders and leading HealthTech investors.
* You will have direct access to the founders, meaningful founding\-level equity, significant autonomy, and the chance to build the ML infrastructure of a product that could reach billions of people.



  





 Package:
 


* Salary: €90,000 \- €130,000 depending on experience
* Equity: Meaningful founding\-level equity available
* Location: Munich city centre
* Working model: In\-office culture
* Start: As soon as possible



  





 Apply if you are a data scientist who wants to own the ML layer of something genuinely ambitious in AI HealthTech, please apply or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

* un environnement bienveillant (travail en équipe, partage des connaissances, …)

**Deine Aufgaben**
**Über Perelyn**
 Perelyn ist eine KI\-Beratung, die bedeutungsvolle Innovation mit KI ermöglicht. Wir verbinden tiefe wissenschaftliche Expertise mit unternehmerischem Verständnis: Research at heart, Business in mind.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Organisationen verschiedenster Branchen zusammen, von der Strategie bis zur produktionsreifen Umsetzung. Unser Team vereint promovierte Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler mit erfahrenen Führungskräften aus Unternehmen wie Amazon, SAP, Munich Re und von der Stanford University. Wir sind überzeugt: Vielfältige Teams entwickeln kreativere, durchdachtere Lösungen und erzielen bessere Ergebnisse.
   

  

 Mit Hauptsitz in München und europäischer Präsenz gestalten wir die Zukunft der KI\-Beratung.
   

  

**Die Rolle**
 Als Principal Consultant AI Solutions machst Du aus KI\-Potenzial echten Geschäftsnutzen. Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, baust die Lösung und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass sie geliefert wird.
   

  

 Du verantwortest komplexe KI\-Engagements von Anfang bis Ende: die Identifikation des richtigen Anwendungsfalls, die Entwicklung des Business Case gemeinsam mit unserer AI Strategy \& Value Practice, die Gestaltung der Lösungsarchitektur und die Steuerung eines Teams bis zum Ergebnis, auf das der Kunde zählen kann.
   

  

 Du fühlst dich gleichermaßen wohl, wenn Du im Vorstandsgespräch die Richtung vorgibst, wie wenn Du bei einem engen Termin oder einem turbulenten Projektverlauf selbst mit anpackst. Du hast anspruchsvolle Arbeiten unter Druck und Unsicherheit wiederholt erfolgreich abgeschlossen und misst Erfolg an den Ergebnissen Deiner Kunden, nicht an den Deliverables, die Du übergibst.
   

  

 Intern spielst Du eine Schlüsselrolle bei unserer KI\-nativen Transformation: Du prägst, wie wir KI in unserer eigenen Praxis einsetzen, und setzt den Standard für das Team.
   

  

**Deine Aufgaben**
*Client Engagement \& Delivery*
* Du verantwortest die Umsetzung komplexer KI\-Projekte vom Proof\-of\-Concept bis zum Produktiveinsatz und hältst Scope, Qualität und Zeitpläne auch unter Druck im Griff.
* Du leitest KI\-Strategie\-Workshops und Assessments mit Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträgern auf C\-Level, um wirkungsstarke KI\-Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
* Du führst Projektteams zu erfolgreichen Ergebnissen, triffst die Entscheidungen, die die Delivery am Laufen halten, und stärkst das Vertrauen des Kunden.
* Du entwirfst und konzipierst KI\-Lösungen über das gesamte Spektrum: etwa Generative AI, klassisches Machine Learning, Computer Vision sowie MLOps und LLMOps.
* Du begleitest Build\-vs.\-Buy\-Entscheidungen und evaluierst Modelle, Technologie\-Stacks und Infrastrukturoptionen für Enterprise\-Kunden.
* Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpunkt für den Kunden: Du antizipierst Bedürfnisse, erkennst, wo weitere KI\-Initiativen Wert schaffen können, und entwickelst aus zufriedenen Kunden langfristige Partner.
* Du gestaltest neue Projektangebote mit und treibst Discovery\- und Scoping\-Gespräche mit potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden aktiv voran, und hilfst dabei, deren Bedürfnisse in klar definierte, umsetzbare Engagements zu übersetzen.


*Thought Leadership \& interne Wirkung*
* Du treibst Perelyns KI\-native Transformation voran, indem Du den Einsatz von KI\-Tools, Workflows und Methoden innerhalb unserer eigenen Praxis wegweisend gestaltest.
* Du trägst zum Wissensaufbau bei, etwa durch Publikationen, Konferenzbeiträge, Workshops oder kundenorientierte Thought Leadership.
* Du mentorst und entwickelst Consultants und förderst eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und hoher Ansprüche.
* Du gestaltest Serviceangebote und Methoden auf Basis aktueller KI\-Trends weiter, einschließlich KI\-Compliance und \-Sicherheit.


**Dein Profil**
**Must\-Have**
* Technischer Hintergrund in AI/ML mit Praxiserfahrung: Du hast Modelle in einem professionellen Umfeld aufgebaut, trainiert oder deployed, zum Beispiel als ML Engineer, Data Scientist oder AI Researcher.
* Eine nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung mehrerer bedeutender Projekte von Anfang bis Ende, auch unter engen Deadlines und sich verändernden Anforderungen, mit voller Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.
* Mehr als 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon ein relevanter Teil in kundenseitigen oder cross\-funktionalen Rollen.
* Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Projektteams erfolgreich zu führen: Du steuerst erfahrene Experten und entwickelst Junior Consultants gleichermaßen, durch echte technische Tiefe, Entschlossenheit und Urteilsvermögen in unklaren Situationen.
* Echte Kundenorientierung: Du gewinnst schnell Vertrauen und stellst das Ergebnis für den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt jeder Entscheidung.
* Die Fähigkeit, souverän zwischen verschiedenen Zielgruppen zu wechseln: klar und glaubwürdig sowohl im Gespräch mit Führungskräften als auch mit Ingenieuren und Wissenschaftlern.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der KI\-Landschaft: LLMs, Generative AI, MLOps/LLMOps und aktuelle Best Practices für KI im Enterprise\-Umfeld.
* Fließende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Promotion oder Master\-Abschluss in Informatik, AI/ML, Mathematik, Physik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
* Erfahrung in der Beratung, bei einer Managementberatung, einem Technologieunternehmen oder einer spezialisierten KI\-Boutique.
* Expertise in KI\-Compliance, Trustworthy AI oder KI\-Sicherheit.
* Branchenkenntnis in einem oder mehreren Sektoren, etwa Energie, Fertigung, Finanzdienstleistungen oder Handel.
* Ein bestehendes professionelles Netzwerk im DACH\-KI\-Ökosystem.
* Publikationen oder öffentliche Vorträge zu KI\-Themen.


**Warum wir?**

 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What you\`ll do:**
 You’ll work at the intersection of advanced AI research, enterprise applications, and real\-world problem solving, partnering closely with internal teams and model researchers to evaluate and improve high\-value use cases.
   

  

 In this applied, hands\-on role, you’ll analyze challenging use cases across the organization, understand their business context, and help push our tabular foundation models to their full potential. Through debugging, benchmarking, and deep technical iteration, you’ll uncover patterns, limitations, and opportunities, and turn them into actionable insights that directly inform model research and model architecture improvements.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate deeply with application teams and domain experts, serving as a bridge between practical use\-case execution and ongoing model research. Your input will have a direct impact on how our models evolve and how effectively they perform on meaningful enterprise problems.
   

  

**The Role**
* Partner with internal teams and model researchers to evaluate high\-value use cases and understand their business context.
* Analyze use cases across the organization and advise on how to make them work effectively with our tabular foundation models.
* Work hands\-on with cutting\-edge tabular foundation models to debug and benchmark model behavior, pushing performance on meaningful enterprise problems.
* Distill patterns, limitations, and opportunities from applied work into actionable insights, including suggestions for improvements to model architecture.


**What You Bring**
* PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or other relevant disciplines with 5\+ years of professional experience in developing machine learning models.
* Extensive hands\-on experience developing predictive use cases on tabular data in a data scientist role, ideally with S/4HANA data.
* Deep master of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including application to structured enterprise data, along with strong software engineering skills in Python and a proven track record of building and scaling experiments with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-cultural teams.

 SAP is uniquely positioned to lead the next wave of AI by infusing intelligence directly into the business processes that run the world. Our team’s mission is to develop Foundation Models for structured data, starting with the launch and continued evolution of SAP\-RPT\-1\. As the first generation of our relational model portfolio, SAP\-RPT\-1 represents our commitment to pioneering new research in a domain where SAP’s expertise in enterprise data structures provides an unmatched competitive edge.  SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. description:
**Über uns**  
Während unsere Großeltern noch regelmäßig natürliche Produkte wie Honig und Propolis in die Ernährung der Familie zur Unterstützung des Immunsystems integrierten, findet man heute so gut wie keine natürlichen Produkte mehr. Genau das wollen wir mit bedrop ändern!

Wir bringen Natur und Wissenschaft zusammen. Dafür entwickeln wir Premium\-Produkte im Bereich Consumer Healthcare und Beauty, die echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffen. Unsere Marke wächst stark – über unseren Webshop genauso wie über zahlreiche weitere Vertriebskanäle (Marktplätze, Retail, internationale Märkte).

**Deine Rolle**  
Als Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Daten und den Menschen, die auf ihrer Basis Entscheidungen treffen. Du verwandelst Zahlen in Insights, Insights in Empfehlungen – und Empfehlungen in messbares Wachstum. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Management sowie mit den Teams aus Marketing, E\-Commerce, Operations, Finance, Produktentwicklung und externen Partnern zusammen.

**Tätigkeiten**

* Du baust unsere Business\-Intelligence\-Landschaft strategisch aus: von der Datenarchitektur über Dashboards bis hin zu Self\-Service\-Reporting für alle Fachbereiche

* Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Business\-Verständnis – du denkst über die Zahl hinaus und triffst Entscheidungen mit Wirkung

description:
Lass uns gemeinsam neue Wege gehen! Denn genau das tun wir bei der R\+V, einem der größten Versicherer Deutschlands.


Willkommen im Ressort Kompositversicherung. Wir bieten für alle Zielgruppen und Vertriebswege bedarfsgerechte, innovative sowie serviceorientierte Produkte und Dienstleistungen unter anderem in den Bereichen Banken / Kredit, Rechtsschutz, Kraftfahrt, Firmenkunden, Agrar und Transport inklusive der Schadenbearbeitung.


**AUFGABEN**
------------


* Du verantwortest die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Fraudmanagements im Antrags\- und Bestandsprozess und entwickelst relevante Analyse\- und Steuerungsansätze.
* Du analysierst Antrags\- und Bestandsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und Muster und leitest daraus wirksame Maßnahmen für Prävention, Erkennung und datenbasierte Steuerung ab.
* Du konzipierst und bewertest Use Cases, Scorings und Analyseansätze, überführst diese in belastbare Business Cases und machst ihren fachlichen und wirtschaftlichen Mehrwert transparent.
* Du beobachtest relevante Entwicklungen am Markt, bewertest neue Technologien und datengetriebene Ansätze und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für unsere Abteilung ab.
* Du bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht für Management und Stakeholder auf und vertrittst deine Empfehlungen klar, fundiert und überzeugend.
* Du übernimmst die Vertretung im Topbeschwerdemanagement und stellst dabei eine fachlich fundierte, adressatengerechte und konforme Bearbeitung managementadressierter Beschwerden sicher.


**PROFIL / ANFORDERUNGEN**
--------------------------


* Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel in (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Fach.
* Erste belastbare praktische Erfahrung in einem datengetriebenen, finanzwirtschaftlichen oder vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld; ein Berufseinstieg mit einschlägiger Praxiserfahrung ist ausdrücklich willkommen.
* Gute Kenntnisse in Python oder R sowie SQL und Erfahrung darin, strukturierte Daten systematisch auszuwerten und verständlich aufzubereiten.
* Interesse an analytischen Fragestellungen rund um Fraud, Qualität, Prozesse und digitale Weiterentwicklung.
* Ein gutes Gespür für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Fähigkeit, analytische Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu übersetzen.
* Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in Präsentation und adressatengerechter Aufbereitung komplexer Inhalte, insbesondere für Management\- und Entscheidungsvorlagen.
* Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Eigenständigkeit und Durchsetzungsstärke und pflegst zugleich eine verbindliche, wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden und Schnittstellen.


**BENEFITS**
------------


Du willst mit Daten echte Wirkung erzielen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Themen mit Relevanz sichtbar voranbringen? Du willst Fraudmanagement weiterentwickeln, neue Ansätze in die Umsetzung bringen und damit einen messbaren Beitrag zu Steuerung, Effizienz und Ergebnis leisten?


Dann ist das deine Chance, ein wichtiges Zukunftsfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.


Im Bereich Kraftfahrt\-Betrieb der R\+V laufen alle zentralen Themen rund um Antrags\- und Bestandsprozesse zusammen.


In dieser neu geschaffenen Funktion übernimmst du die fachliche Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unseres Fraudmanagements. Gleichzeitig treibst Du datenbasierte und digitale Ansätze voran. Mit klarem Business\-Fokus schaffst Du die Grundlagen für wirksame Maßnahmen mit klaren Erfolgskennzahlen.

**Homeoffice:** Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice und Büro. Mehr Infos zu unserem hybriden Arbeiten findest Du hier.

**Arbeitszeiten:** Standardmäßig 38h\-Woche, Zeiterfassungssystem, Gleitzeit \& Lebensarbeitszeitkonto.

**Urlaub:** 30 Tage Urlaub \& zusätzliche arbeitsfreie Tage (24\.12\. und 31\.12\.).

**Vergütung:** 14 Monatsgehälter (inkl. Weihnachts\- \& Urlaubsgeld) oder Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem, Sonderzahlungen, Mitarbeitertarife \& Rabattaktionen.

**Gesundheit:** Betriebliche Altersvorsorge \& Gesundheitsmanagement mit vielfältigen Angeboten. Unser hauseigenes Fitnessstudio und ein breites Netzwerk von Sportangeboten (Wellpass) stehen Dir zudem online und bundesweit zur Verfügung.

**Mobilität:** Jobticket, Jobrad/Fahrradleasing, verkehrsgünstige Lage mit überdachten Fahrradparkplätzen.

**Familie \& Beruf:** Eltern\-Kind\-Büros, Kindernotfallbetreuung, eigene Kindertagespflege „Raiffeisenzwerge“ sowie Pflegenetzwerk \& Unterstützung durch die R\+V\-Sozialberatung.

**Kulinarik:** Gesunde \& ausgewogene Speisen in unserem Betriebsrestaurant.

**Weiterentwicklung:** Förderung \& Weiterentwicklung durch die R\+V Akademie. Die Übernahme externer Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen komplettiert Deine persönliche sowie fachliche Entwicklung.

**Kultur:** Wir leben Gemeinschaft. Unser Motto „Was einer nicht schafft, schaffen viele“ spiegelt sich auch in unseren Teams und dem täglichen Miteinander wider.


**Jetzt bewerben**

### **Wir benötigen Ihre Zustimmung, um den Smart Recruiters Job\-Alert\-Service zu laden!**


Wir verwenden Smart Recruiters Job\-Alert, um Inhalte einzubetten. Dieser Service kann Daten zu Ihren Aktivitäten sammeln. Bitte lesen Sie die Details durch und stimmen Sie der Nutzung des Service zu, um diese Inhalte anzuzeigen.

* Kenntnisse einschlägiger Analyse\- und Sequenziermethoden, Datenbanken und Statistikverfahren

title: Senior Consultant Data Science (w/m/d)
description:
Als Senior Consultant Data Science (w/m/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen Teams von Data\-Experts, die innovative und datengesteuerte Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Data Scientists zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, an verschiedenen Projekten und Herausforderungen mitzuwirken.
   

  

**Deine Aufgaben**
* Du bereitest komplexe Daten auf, modellierst, analysierst und visualisierst sie. Außerdem entwickelst Du mathematische und Machine Learning Modelle in Batch\- und Real\-Time\-Kontext, um Lösungen für Probleme und Anforderungen zu erarbeiten. Dabei bewertest Du KI Use Cases, recherchierst geeignete Methoden und wendest diese auf Echtdaten an.
* Du betreust nationale und internationale Projekte an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT.
* In teamorientierten, interdisziplinären und agilen Projekten auf Augenhöhe bringst Du Dich und deine Expertise ein.
* Du konzipierst und entwickelst Lösungen auf modernen Plattformen und Cloud\-Umgebungen wie z.B. Azure oder AWS.
* Durch einen abwechslungsreichen und herausfordernden Arbeitsalltag sowie vielseitige Schulungen für Methodik, Fachwissen und technische Fähigkeiten kannst Du eine steile Lernkurve erleben.
* Zudem bringst Du Deine Interessen und kreativen Ideen in Initiativen und in Zusammenarbeit mit Kooperationspartner\*innen ein, um aktuelle Trends am Markt mitzugestalten.


**Dein Profil**
* Du hast einen Studienabschluss in Informatik, (Wirtschafts\-)Mathematik, Physik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
* Außerdem hast Du erste berufliche Erfahrungen, idealerweise in der Unternehmensberatung oder der IT.
* Du verfügst über Methodenwissen in Statistik, Machine Learning und IT\-Infrastrukturen sowie erste Erfahrungen in der Anwendung von Machine Learning Modellen.
* Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, gerne flankiert durch Erfahrung im Bereich Datenbanken wie SQL/postgreSQL.
* An der kooperativen Arbeit in agilen Projektteams hast Du Interesse.
* An komplexen Aufgaben und dem Umgang mit Daten hast Du Freude.
* Du bist reisebereit und flexibel.
* Du verfügst über Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch auf C1\-Level und Englisch auf B2\-Level.
* Idealerweise hast Du darüber hinaus Grundkenntnisse in der API\-Entwicklung, einen sicheren Umgang mit Versionsverwaltung via git und Grundkenntnisse in LaTeX.


**Deine Benefits**
* **Willkommen im Team** 
 Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding\-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.
* **Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven** 
 Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback\-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Ab dem Level Manager und Managerin kannst Du auch Personal\- und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen. Deine Führungskompetenz fördern wir mit individuellem Coaching und spezifischen Führungstrainings. Als Teil des weltweiten KPMG\-.Netzwerks bieten wir Dir zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten im In\- und Ausland und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche.
* **Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben** 
 Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice\-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat\- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren.
* **Fort\- \& Weiterbildung** 
 Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Deine Fähigkeiten stetig weiter. Zudem fördern wir Berufsexamina sowie berufsbegleitende Master\-Studiengänge. Mit unseren Rotationsprogrammen ermöglichen wir Deinen fachübergreifenden Einsatz. Diese Einblicke in die vielfältigen Aufgabenfelder bei KPMG erweitern Deinen Horizont und fördern Synergien in der Zusammenarbeit.
* Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

title: Senior / Lead Data Scientist – Applied Statistics & Machine Learning – €100,000+
description:
**Senior / Lead Data Scientist – Applied Statistics \& Machine Learning – €100,000\+**




  





 A growing AI engineering consultancy in Frankfurt is hiring a Senior / Lead Data Scientist to help solve complex real\-world problems across healthcare, insurance, finance, energy and manufacturing.
 



  





 The most successful people in this team are naturally sceptical. They question the data before the model. They care about statistical rigour. They understand that a surprisingly good result is often the first thing that deserves investigating.
 



  





 You’ll work directly with customers, taking projects from problem definition through to deployment and stakeholder presentation. The work is varied, technically challenging, and focused on delivering outcomes that stand up in production.
 



  





**Why this role stands out** 



* Work on genuinely varied projects across multiple industries
* High level of ownership and customer exposure
* Strong engineering culture focused on quality over hype
* Opportunity to grow into a Lead Data Scientist position



  





**What you’ll work on** 



* Predictive analytics and machine learning projects across multiple industries
* Statistical analysis of messy, incomplete and real\-world datasets
* Time series, tabular, text and occasionally image\-based data problems
* Customer\-facing consulting and technical delivery
* End\-to\-end project ownership from discovery through to deployment



  





**What they’re looking for** 



* Several years of commercial Data Science or Machine Learning experience
* Strong statistical foundations and a genuine understanding of uncertainty, hypothesis testing and model evaluation
* Excellent Python skills and experience with modern ML frameworks



  





 If you’re the type of Data Scientist who wants to understand the problem before reaching for the algorithm, we’d love to speak with you.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. With our unique combination of data, analytics and software, we have established ourselves as one of the leading service providers for risk, fraud and identity management in the DACH region.
   

  

 Experian gives individuals better access to financial services such as loans, insurance, mobile phone contracts and online shopping. We help companies of all sizes and industries make smarter decisions, lend more responsibly and protect themselves and their customers from identity fraud and crime.
   

  

 We invest in our talented people and new, advanced technologies to harness the power of data and drive innovation. We employ 25,100 people in 32 countries and are a FTSE 100 company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN). Our headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Introduction of role, purpose** 
**:**
 The Data Scientist plays a pivotal role in the development and application of advanced analytics and machine learning models to support the development, monitoring, and maintenance of our data products, including Scores, Attributes, and other Data Services. This role is integral to driving innovation and improving the performance of our products, working closely with our Data Engineering, Product \& Tech teams ensuring data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 The primary purpose of this role is to develop, implement, and maintain machine learning models and analytical solutions that enhance our data products. It also includes the monitoring of our Bureau Data Asset and the continues improvement of our Bureau Data Ingestion Pipeline.
   

  

 Main focus of this role are product\-related tasks with only limited or no involvement in client projects.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities, Tasks, Duties**
* Develop and implement machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions
* Monitor the performance and quality of our models and data products
* Perform ad hoc analyses to support product development and decision\-making
* Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Product \& Tech teams to understand functional requirements and to ensure proper implementation of analytical solutions, new product features and improve processes
* Ensure model accuracy and integrity through rigorous testing and validation processes
* Document methodologies, processes, and findings to maintain transparency and reproducibility
* Extract, manipulate, and analyze data from data lake to support various product development and monitoring activities
* Support our Legal and Compliance Teams in cases of consumer complaints, questions regarding our Scores and regulatory or policy changes
* Stay up to date on industry trends and new developments in machine learning and data science


**Responsibility, E.g. Budget, Key Deliverables**
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality machine learning models and analyses
* Maintain and improve the accuracy and performance of our models and data products
* Contribute to the development of new product features and enhancements
* Support data\-driven decision making within Product Management
* Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic decision\-making


**Qualifications**
**Required qualification, expertise, skills:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail
* Deep knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms, especially logistic regression and boosted trees and its application
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Scala
* Experience with machine learning frameworks such as XGBoost, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn
* Experience with data manipulation and extraction from data lakes or large data storages using SQL and Spark
* Proven ability to analyze complex business and risk processes, translating them into actionable data models


**Preferred Further Skills (not Mandatory)**
* We are not looking for a pure theorist: You should have the ability to interpret and apply analytical models within a business context. Ideally, you have demonstrated how to analyze business processes and translate them into data models to enable data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience in the credit bureau or financial services environment is a plus, but not mandatory
* Strong ability to communicate complex analytical results clearly and provide actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills


 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
   

  

**Benefits/Perks**
**Additional Information**
* A high degree of autonomy in a dynamic, internationally oriented organization
* A motivated team that values innovation and collaboration
* Great compensation package and attractive employee benefits
* Flexible working hours and remote work options

#### **Este reto es para ti si...**

* Cuentas con una **Licenciatura o Grado en Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería** o una disciplina cuantitativa similar.
* Aportas una **experiencia mínima de 3 años** trabajando activamente con modelos de Machine Learning y un **dominio avanzado de Python** aplicado a Data Science.

* Eres capaz de traducir la complejidad técnica en visualizaciones claras e impactantes, comunicando tus hallazgos de forma efectiva a perfiles de negocio.
* Tienes un **nivel de inglés alto (C1 o similar)**, que te permite comunicarte, investigar y colaborar en un contexto global sin barreras.

#### **Qué harás...**


Tu misión principal será diseñar, entrenar y desplegar el marco técnico de soluciones avanzadas de ML e IA Generativa para responder a los retos del negocio. En tu día a día, te encargarás de:

* **Liderar el desarrollo de productos de IA:** Desde la conceptualización técnica hasta el *fine\-tuning* y despliegue de plataformas innovadoras basadas en modelos de lenguaje y generación de contenido.
* **Optimizar procesos de negocio:** Identificar y priorizar oportunidades donde la analítica avanzada pueda marcar la diferencia (personalización, atención al cliente, gestión de stock).
* **Garantizar la calidad del dato (*****Data Lineage*****):** Asegurar la trazabilidad y curación de los datos desde sus fuentes originales para optimizar el rendimiento predictivo.

* **Evaluar tecnologías y alianzas:** Investigar y recomendar nuevas soluciones o *partnerships* de IA que aporten una ventaja competitiva diferencial.
* **Contribuir al control financiero (ROI):** Colaborar con el *Artificial Intelligence Manager* aportando métricas y análisis técnicos para asegurar que cada solución tecnológica genere un valor real y medible.

#### **Lo que ofrecemos...**

title: Neuroscience, HCI & Cognitive Research Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Neuroscience, HCI \& Cognitive Research Lead is a high\-level, senior individual contributor (IC) role designed for an expert who bridges the gap between cognitive neuroscience, quantitative Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and high\-density interface design.


Instead of managing people, you will lead the scientific and interaction strategy for the Doodle product ecosystem. Your goal is to systematically decode how humans perceive time, experience decision fatigue during group time coordination, and interact with automated time\-creation systems. You will turn hard cognitive metrics into concrete design principles that our product and UX teams can execute immediately.

### **What You’ll Actually Do**

**1\. Strategic Research Leadership**

* Establish and track **quantitative cognitive KPIs** to measure interaction quality across all core workflows.
* Embed behavioral evaluation frameworks directly into the quarterly product roadmap prioritization process.
* Identify and mitigate behavioral and cognitive risks in product feature specs before they reach engineering development.

**2\. Applied Neuroscience \& Cognitive Research**

* Design and execute rigorous experiments evaluating user attention allocation, interruption costs, and information processing limits.
* Conduct deep\-dive research into **temporal cognition**, which is how users psychologically process time, waiting periods, and availability synchronization.
* Translate neuro\-cognitive theories of habit formation and collective coordination into practical product loops.

**3\. HCI \& High\-Density Interface Design**

* Analyze and optimize complex, high\-density time coordination interfaces to minimize visual noise and cognitive friction.
* Develop clear, neuroscience\-informed guidelines for font hierarchy, information chunking, and layout structures that reduce user anxiety during high\-stakes availability matching.
* Evaluate the psychological boundaries of **Human\-AI interaction**, focusing on building appropriate user trust, transparency, and control in automated time\-creation flows.

**4\. Interaction \& Systems Thinking**

* Map holistic user attention flows across asynchronous digital ecosystems, looking beyond single\-page sessions to understand multi\-day coordination loops.
* Diagnose systemic cognitive bottlenecks in complex B2B group time\-creation journeys.
* Predict and measure the downstream psychological effects of notifications, alerts, and calendar interruptions on user focus.

**5\. Organizational Research Enablement**

* Run targeted workshops and continuous coaching sessions for Product Managers (PMs) and Product Designers to upgrade internal literacy in behavioral economics and HCI principles.
* Build a reusable, centralized repository of cognitive design patterns, validation checklists, and experimental frameworks.
* Scale evidence\-based product development by teaching teams how to run quick, statistically valid A/B behavioral checks.

**6\. Long\-Term Innovation Research**

* Craft early, visionary interaction prototypes utilizing AI tools to rapidly simulate underlying logic, test behavioral hypotheses, and represent complex systemic ideas.
* Anticipate the future of asynchronous alignment by exploring next\-generation paradigms: ambient computing, voice/natural language coordination, and zero\-UI predictive automation.
* Build foundational mental models for how users will collaborate as AI agents increasingly handle automated time creation on their behalf.

**7\. Product Strategy \& Business Impact**

* Align user cognitive comfort directly with core B2B business metrics, proving how reduced decision fatigue drives increased user retention, higher conversion rates, and lower churn.
* Synthesize complex academic and experimental data into crisp, highly commercial briefs for executive leadership to steer long\-term portfolio investments.

#### **High\-Complexity Technical Scopes**


To illustrate the expected depth of this role, you will architect and execute research initiatives addressing multi\-layered cognitive and behavioral friction points:

**Scenario A: Structural Complexity and Working Memory Constraints in Collective Alignment**

* **The Problem:** Multi\-party, multi\-layered time coordination inherently scales cognitive friction due to the high volume of asynchronous variables processed simultaneously. When interaction systems fail to account for biological limits on visual working memory, users experience rapid cognitive fatigue, stalling the time\-creation lifecycle.
* **Your Scope:** You will architect advanced, non\-invasive experimental protocols to evaluate how distinct information architecture patterns tax human processing capacity. Your role is to define the fundamental cognitive thresholds that govern complex data visualization in coordination systems, equipping our core design and engineering teams with the foundational interaction rules needed to prevent cognitive overload.

**Scenario B: Dynamic Calibration of Intent and Automation in AI\-Mediated Systems**

* **The Problem:** The shifting frontier of intelligent, predictive systems introduces a fundamental human\-machine friction point: balancing user intent with autonomous system execution. In structural time creation, poor calibration of this boundary triggers either hyper\-vigilant friction (due to low trust) or systemic errors (due to automation complacency).
* **Your Scope:** You will design systemic Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI) evaluation methodologies to study user agency across varying levels of automated coordination. By mapping how changes in interface responsiveness, information transparency, and state\-sharing affect user mental models, you will establish the baseline psychological criteria required for humans to seamlessly co\-operate with autonomous agents.

### **What do you bring?**

**Years of Experience \& Environments**

* **7 to 12\+ years** of post\-qualification experience as an applied researcher, product strategist, or interaction architect.
* Must have a proven track record operating within **fast\-paced commercial digital product companies** (SaaS, B2B/B2C productivity tools, collaboration platforms, or high\-velocity tech labs).
* *Note:* Purely academic profiles or individuals who have only worked in traditional UX agency settings will not have the required product exposure for this role.

**Technical \& Scientific Maturity**

* **Educational Depth:** Master’s or PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, Behavioral Economics, or Experimental/Computational Psychology.
* **Methodological Mastery:** Deep expertise in advanced experimental design, statistical analysis, quantitative usability testing, eye\-tracking methodologies, cognitive load testing, and longitudinal behavioral studies.
* **The Blueprint Balance:** You possess the scientific maturity to know when to demand strict academic rigor and when to optimize for rapid tech\-product velocity.

**Autonomy \& Product Exposure**

* **100% Autonomous Execution:** This is a senior IC role. You do not need a manager to scope your projects, build your test environments, or interpret your data. You own the cognitive research roadmap end\-to\-end.
* **Deep Design \& Product Fluency:** You speak the native language of product squads. You can effortlessly jump into a Figma file with a Principal Product Designer to critique layout density, sit with a PM to redefine a feature's conversion funnel, or sync with a Data Scientist on behavioral telemetry tracking.

**Expected Outcomes \& Measurable Metrics**


Success in this role will not be judged by the number of research papers written, but by the tangible improvement of our user experience and product metrics:

* **Product Performance:** Measurable reduction in user drop\-off rates and time\-to\-completion within high\-density time creation workflows.
* **Cognitive Efficiency:** Lowered subjective and objective cognitive friction indexes across core user journeys, verified through continuous panel testing.
* **Design Velocity:** Creation of a finalized, adopted "Doodle Cognitive Design Manual" used daily by product design teams to ship interfaces that respect human attention.
* **Strategic Moat:** Development of proprietary, defensible behavioral frameworks around how humans coordinate time, positioning Doodle as the definitive global thought leader in the evolution of interaction system design.

### **Why Doodle?**

* **Real Impact:** Your commits will change how the world meets.
* **Technical Stretch:** We deal with "Time" problems most companies never encounter. It’s a masterclass in distributed logic.


At Doodle, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual trust and respect, where equal employment opportunities (EEO) are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to age, race, color, disability, religion, gender, and sexual orientation. Diversity and inclusion are of utmost importance to us. We’re committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work and our products will be. We want to hear from you, so please don’t hesitate to apply!We look forward to receiving your full application.

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:** *Please note that we can only consider your application if you are* ***based and have the right to work in Spain*** *At this time, we are unable to sponsor visa for this position or support with relocation.*
